title: TwinSight telemetry contract
description: JSON over WebSocket shared by the Cloudflare worker (24/7 replay, 'Sombra digital'), the local PX4 SITL bridge ('Gemelo digital SITL') and every client (web, Unity desktop). Source of truth in code: src/shared/protocol.ts. The root validates any single wire message (server -> client or client -> server); use '#/$defs/<Name>' to validate a specific type. Units: NED metres, m/s; quaternion Hamilton scalar first rotating body FRD into world NED; u 0..1; rpm; degrees Celsius; ts in ms. Readers must ignore unknown fields (forward compatibility); this schema is strict (additionalProperties false) so that any new field in a server must be declared here first.

Seq.description: Contract 1.1, optional. Sender sequence number: non-negative integer, strictly increasing per sender and per connection (one counter shared by 'command' and 'manual'; restarts on a new socket). Receivers drop a 'manual' whose seq is not above the last accepted one and refuse a 'command' in that case. Absent in 1.0.0 senders: receivers must accept its absence.

SenderTs.description: Contract 1.1, optional. Sender wall clock when the message was produced, epoch ms. Clocks are not synchronised: receivers compare it only against the smallest (receive time - ts) seen on the connection; a 'manual' more than 150 ms older than that is dropped, a 'command' more than 2000 ms older is refused. Absent in 1.0.0 senders.

Quat.description: [w, x, y, z]. Hamilton, scalar first, rotates body FRD into world NED (PX4 vehicle_attitude.q). Unit norm (tolerance 1e-3 after 3-decimal rounding); not enforceable in JSON Schema, checked by the tests.

Temp6.description: Degrees Celsius: [motor 1, motor 2, motor 3, motor 4, battery, flight controller].

km.description: Moment coefficient: > 0 is CCW seen from above, < 0 is CW (PX4 control_allocator).

WireCode.description: Contract 1.2: translatable code of an ack or of hello.source (docs/CONTRATO_1_2.md section 8). The client translates 'wire.ack.<code>' / 'wire.source.<code>' with its own dictionary and falls back to the server text (detail / label) when it does not know the code.

WireParams.description: Contract 1.2: values for the translation of a code (text or number). 'px4' carries PX4's own STATUSTEXT, never translated.

GpsState.description: Contract 1.2, optional in the frame: GPS state from MAVLink GPS_RAW_INT (bridge). Absent in the replay (the file has no GPS) and in the browser simulator. Origin: Provenance.gps (in SITL it is Gazebo's simulated GPS).

fix.description: MAVLink GPS_FIX_TYPE: 0 no GPS, 1 no fix, 2 2D, 3 3D, 4 DGPS, 5 RTK float, 6 RTK fixed, 7 static, 8 PPP.

hdop.description: Horizontal dilution of precision, unitless (GPS_RAW_INT.eph / 100); absent = unknown (65535).

EscState.description: Contract 1.2, optional in the frame: MEASURED ESC telemetry (MAVLink ESC_STATUS), only with real ESC telemetry (HITL or a physical vehicle; bridge option --esc-telemetry). gz SITL never sends it (its ESC_STATUS echoes the command). When present, TelemetryFrame.rpm is the same measured speed and Provenance.rpm is 'measured'.

rpm.description: Measured rotor speed per ESC, RPM, PX4 motor order 1..4.

ts.description: Stream time in ms (wall-clock epoch ms emitted by the server). Monotonic within a connection; the interpolation buffer runs on it.

lt.description: Log time (replay) or vehicle boot time (SITL), seconds. Display only.

seg.description: Segment id. Changes on discontinuities (replay loop wrap); never interpolate across it.

p.description: Local position NED, metres, relative to the EKF origin.

rpm.description: Rotor speed, RPM, PX4 motor order 1..4. Origin depends on Provenance.rpm (estimated in replay, 'command' in SITL).

ProvenanceRpm.description: Where rotor speed comes from: measured (ESC telemetry), estimated (model), command (the speed command sent to the simulator).

ProvenanceState.description: Contract 1.2: origin of the pose and velocity channels.

ProvenanceSensor.description: Contract 1.2: origin of GPS and ESC telemetry. In SITL 'measured' is a simulated sensor (shown as simulated).

Provenance.description: Which telemetry channels are measured and which are model estimates. Shown in the UI; no reading may reach the screen without its origin.

batteryCurrent.description: Optional: absent for older servers (treat as measured). SITL reports 0 A, so the bridge estimates it from rotor speed.

pose.description: Contract 1.2, optional (decision D-10, default and reversible): attitude and position. 'estimated' in the replay and in PX4 SITL (EKF2 output, not a direct sensor). Absent = what the client assumed before 1.2.

velocity.description: Contract 1.2, optional (D-10): velocity, 'estimated' (EKF2) in the replay and in PX4 SITL.

gps.description: Contract 1.2, optional: TelemetryFrame.gps. 'unavailable' in the replay.

esc.description: Contract 1.2, optional: TelemetryFrame.esc. Never 'measured' in gz SITL.

Mode.description: Wire mode of the server. 'replay' = digital shadow (label 'Sombra digital'); 'sitl' = closed-loop PX4 SITL (label 'Gemelo digital SITL').

SourceClassification.description: What the UI shows in the classification badge. The two wire modes plus the local 'inspector' source (no telemetry, never sent on the wire). Texts: contracts/labels.json.

CommandCapability.description: Entries of HelloMessage.commands. Mixed vocabulary, as the servers emit it: message types the server accepts ('inject', 'clear', 'manual') and names of 'command' messages.

WorldInfo.description: Contract 1.2, optional, SCHEMA ONLY (nobody emits it yet; decision D8 pending): the world the vehicle flies in. A decorative scene is 'illustrative' and labelled as such.

id.description: PX4_GZ_WORLD name or own world id.

origin.description: Geographic origin of the EKF frame.

StreamInfo.description: Contract 1.2, optional, SCHEMA ONLY: a video stream. Video travels OUTSIDE this WebSocket.

HelloMessage.description: First message after connecting. A new hello means a new session: clear buffers, clock and ground reference.

rateHz.description: Nominal frame rate of the source (0 for the local Inspector).

ambientC.description: Ambient temperature the thermal models start from, degrees Celsius.

label.description: Free text, Spanish only (see README, discrepancias). Since 1.2 the fallback of source.code.

code.description: Contract 1.2, optional: translatable code of label (replay.flightReview, replay.local, inspector, sim.browser, sitl.gz); label stays as the fallback.

commands.description: Commands the server accepts from the client.

serverTime.description: Server wall clock, epoch ms (0 for the local Inspector).

protocolVersion.description: Contract 1.1, optional: version of this contract the server speaks. Absent = 1.0.0.

FramesMessage.description: Replay: a batch of frames per 100 ms tick (and up to 40 frames of history on connect). SITL: one frame per message at the bridge rate.

Fault.description: Synthetic fault layered over replayed telemetry (never real). 'motor' is present for motor_failure and motor_overheat only.

until.description: Stream ms. Active while since <= now < until.

FaultsMessage.description: Full list of the active faults; sent on connect and whenever it changes.

EventMessage.description: Free-text event (SITL: PX4 STATUSTEXT, prefixed 'PX4: '). Only the bridge emits it today.

AckMessage.description: Answer to a client message. 'command' is the command name (bridge), or the message type (worker: 'inject', 'clear', 'command', 'manual'), or '?' (bridge: message not understood). 'detail' is free text, Spanish only; since 1.2 it is the fallback of 'code' (+ 'params').

seq.description: 1.1, optional: echo of the seq of the command being answered (absent when that command carried none).

ts.description: 1.1, optional: clock of the server that answers, epoch ms.

code.description: 1.2, optional: translatable code of the answer; detail stays as the Spanish fallback.

params.description: 1.2, optional: values for the translation of code.

ParamId.description: Contract 1.2: PX4 parameter name (at most 16 characters). Which ones may be read or written is policy, not schema: contracts/px4_params.json.

value.description: Value as PX4 reported it (PARAM_VALUE; int32 decoded from PX4's bytewise encoding).

ParamsMessage.description: Contract 1.2: whitelisted PX4 parameters (answer to param_list / param_get / param_set, after the bridge read them from PX4). The relay delivers it to pilot and admin only.

MissionStatusMessage.description: Contract 1.2: state of the mission stored in PX4 (MISSION_CURRENT, MISSION_ITEM_REACHED). Sent when it changes.

id.description: Mission.id of the uploaded mission (absent when this bridge did not upload it).

leg.description: 1-based waypoint being flown to; absent during the takeoff and the final action.

InjectMessage.description: Replay only. motor_failure and motor_overheat need 'motor' (1..4), otherwise the worker answers ack ok=false 'falla no válida'. Rate limit: 1 command per 1.5 s per socket.

ClearMessage.description: Replay only: remove every synthetic fault.

CommandFlyTo.description: Fly to a local NED point (m, relative to the EKF origin, as TelemetryFrame.p) at 'altitude' m. The bridge clamps the target to 200 m from the origin and rejects |north|,|east| > 1e5.

CommandYaw.description: Turn the heading by 'degrees' (+ clockwise seen from above). The bridge rejects 0 and |degrees| > 180.

CommandOrbit.description: Circle the current position at 'radius' m (the bridge clamps to 2..50).

CommandMotorOff.description: Real SITL fault: stop motor 1..4 (MAV_CMD_INJECT_FAILURE). With the bridge configuration (CA_FAILURE_MODE = 1) the rotor command drops to 0 and the simulated vehicle falls.

CommandRestore.description: Undo motor_off on one motor (1..4); with 0 or omitted, undo every injected fault (all motors and battery_off).

CommandBatteryOff.description: Contract 1.1. Real PX4 SITL fault: the battery simulator drains the battery (MAV_CMD_INJECT_FAILURE, unit battery, type off). Measured in PX4 v1.17 SITL with Gazebo: 70 % to 0 % in about 6 s, low-battery warning, emergency landing, disarm. Undone by 'restore' without motor (or motor 0). PX4 SITL only: the browser flight simulator (not PX4) refuses it.

CommandPilot.description: Switch PX4 to Position mode (POSCTL) so it flies the 'manual' stick stream. Sent once when piloting starts.

CommandParamList.description: Contract 1.2: read the whitelisted PX4 parameters. Answer: a params message and an ack (code param.list).

CommandParamGet.description: Contract 1.2: read one whitelisted PX4 parameter (anything else: ack ok=false, code param.notAllowed).

CommandParamSet.description: Contract 1.2: write one PX4 parameter of the whitelist (contracts/px4_params.json: write role, range or allowed values, never_write). Disarmed only. The bridge reads the value back and answers params + ack (code param.set, or param.mismatch / param.noResponse). Unlike altitudes, nothing is clamped: out of range is refused.

MissionWaypoint.description: Waypoint of the Mission document (src/shared/mission.ts): local NED of the EKF origin, m; alt positive up; speed of the leg that ENDS here, m/s; optional wait, s.

Mission.description: The mission document of src/shared/mission.ts (version 1), the same JSON both clients export and import. Servers check it with validateMission and SITL_MISSION_LIMITS (200 m, 1..50 m, 0.5..6 m/s, wait 0..120 s).

CommandMissionSet.description: Contract 1.2: upload a mission to PX4 (MISSION_COUNT / MISSION_REQUEST_INT / MISSION_ITEM_INT / MISSION_ACK). The only client message allowed up to 4096 characters (every other one: 512).

CommandMissionStart.description: Contract 1.2: start or resume the mission stored in PX4 (arms when needed, MAV_CMD_MISSION_START). Pause = hold.

CommandMissionClear.description: Contract 1.2: remove the mission stored in PX4 (MISSION_CLEAR_ALL).

ManualMessage.description: Joystick sample streamed at 25-50 Hz while piloting (SITL only). The bridge forwards it as MAVLink MANUAL_CONTROL, clamps and rounds it, rate-limits it to 60 Hz per client and NEVER acks it.

z.description: Throttle, 500 = hold altitude in Position mode.

ClientMessage.description: Messages a client may send. The servers drop messages longer than 512 characters (4096 for mission_set, contract 1.2) or not valid JSON without any answer.

Alert.description: NOT on the wire: derived client-side by deriveAlerts() (src/shared/alerts.ts) from each displayed frame. 'id' and 'component'/'severity' are normative; 'message' is informational Spanish text; a client translates from 'code' + 'params' (+ 'origin', 'synthetic') with its own dictionary.

params.description: Figures of the message as shown: n (motor), rpm, mean, c (degC), pct, v.

origin.description: Where the figure comes from, when the alert states it.

synthetic.description: A synthetic fault of the replay is active on this alert's component.

AlertSummary.description: NOT on the wire: what the airplane circle shows (alertSummary()).

ThermalOrigin.description: NOT on the wire: origin label of a temperature reading in the UI.

HealthResponse.description: HTTP GET /health of the worker (not a WebSocket message).

TwfHeader.description: JSON header of the TWF1 file (data/x500v2_flight.twf, src/shared/twf.ts) the worker replays and a desktop client may bundle for the local replay. File layout: 'TWF1', u32 LE header length, UTF-8 JSON header, then frame_count x len(fields) little-endian float32 row-major. Open object: extra keys are allowed.
